name: Calendar (CalDAV)
description: Read and write events across one or more calendars on any CalDAV server (self-hosted, iCloud, Fastmail, Nextcloud, …).

serverUrl.description: CalDAV server URL, e.g. https://caldav.icloud.com/ or https://your-pc-wsl.your-tailnet.ts.net/

password.description: App-specific password, never the account's main password.

calendarName.description: Default calendar display name when a tool call doesn't specify one.
